copy.headline: First response under four minutes, on every channel
copy.subhead: How the top quartile of brands actually staff social care.

plate_direction: A deep navy ground, near flat, filling the frame. In the lower half, a real customer-care console on a laptop screen: a queue of conversations and a response-time chart, genuine software interface rather than invented UI. Framed by soft periwinkle geometry - two overlapping circles and a thin arc - with one light hairline connecting them. High contrast, clean product photography. The upper half is unbroken navy with generous empty space.
